name: Aladdin Ali
title: Backend & platform engineer
about: I build systems that stay correct when inputs are messy and dependencies fail: APIs, ingestion pipelines, financial data, and the plumbing between them.

What I care about: idempotency, retries and failure isolation, reconciliation, auditability, and observability. Most of my backend work is C# / .NET, with TypeScript, Postgres, Redis, and Python workers alongside it.
I've also been making games since 2015 (Haxe, HaxeFlixel, Heaps, C#, Godot), and I build the Linux and desktop tools I actually use.
buildingNow: Ground, a financial-analysis platform foundation, and Photon Trail, a personal-finance pipeline.
